message.content: {"question":"The efficiency of a thermal machine (A) is independent of the substance that completes the cycle (B) cannot be equal to one because in practice there are no perfect gases (C) is equal to the ratio between the work done and the absorbed heat (D) holds 1 - T₂/T₁ with T₁ > T₂","options":{"A":"is independent of the substance that completes the cycle","B":"cannot be equal to one because in practice there are no perfect gases","C":"is equal to the ratio between the work done and the absorbed heat","D":"holds 1 - T₂/T₁ with T₁ > T₂"},"correct":"C"}
